title: Endpoint Starter Kit PRD — Acceptance & Launch Runway
creator: Priya Kapoor
overview: This PRD defines the Endpoint Starter Kit: a minimal, consistent bundle of hosted inference endpoints (chat, completions, embeddings, rerank) plus the acceptance checklist, launch runway and operational playbooks required for a safe GA. The goal is to provide a low-friction integration path for early customers and internal product teams while locking down behavior guarantees, observability, and rollback criteria.
goals: 1) Provide a single, documented endpoint bundle that developers can ship against with predictable behavior across lanes. 2) Define precise acceptance criteria (behavioral & SLO) for chat/completions/embeddings/rerank. 3) Ship a reproducible launch runway (canary → staged → GA) with automated smoke/regression checks and immediate rollback triggers. 4) Ensure monitoring, cost telemetry, and quality alerting are live before GA.
scope_included:
- Contract and behavioral guarantees for: chat (turn/state semantics), completions (temperature, max_tokens), embeddings (dimensionality, stable encoding), rerank (score calibration).
- Launch checklist: pre-launch validation, canary ramp plan, rollback gates.
- End-to-end test harness (prompt sets + golden outputs) and perf profiles.
- Console dashboards for latency/cost/quality and alerting rules.
- SDK examples and migration notes for existing customers.
scope_excluded:
- New model training or model architecture changes.
- Dedicated/Dedicated capacity features (reserved capacity procurement).
- Private (on-prem/VPC) deployment specifics beyond API contract.
- Large-scale client migration assistance post-GA (handled by Customer Success separately).
requirements:
Functional: 
- Chat endpoint: supports streaming + structured output (JSON/Delta), token-level cost metrics, session cookies for KV cache hints.
- Completions endpoint: deterministic seeding option, consistent stop-sequence behavior, per-request prompt metadata passthrough.
- Embeddings endpoint: stable embedding versioning (v1), batch endpoints with max batch size 128, consistent L2-normalized output.
- Rerank endpoint: returns score in 0..1, supports candidate list input, optional explanation token spans.
Non-functional:
- Latency p50/p95 targets per lane documented and validated (p95 < 750ms for small models in hosted lane).
- SLOs: 99.9% availability, <0.1% error rate threshold.
- Observability: token-level cost, request traces, model-variant labels, and drift metrics for embeddings.
- Backwards compatibility: existing client calls should continue to function with default behavior unless opting into new flags.
- Security: request auditing and KMS-integrated key tagging for any customer-provided keys.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Contract tests: All public-facing endpoints conform to the API schema; schema changes must be opt-in flags.
2) Behavioral tests: For the canonical prompt set (see QA artifact), output diffs against golden thresholds are within tolerances for chat and completions (no more than 2% of prompts flagged).
3) Embeddings: Cosine similarity on the canonical seed dataset is stable across 10 sequential runs (mean variance < 1e-6).
4) Rerank: Top-1 accuracy change vs baseline <= 1.5% and score calibration validated on holdout dataset.
5) Performance: Measured p50/p95 latency and tail latencies meet documented targets across canary traffic (p95 < 750ms).
6) Observability: Dashboards live, alerting rules tested (simulated degradation triggers alerts and on-call workflows).
7) Security: Security review complete and signed off, KMS integration tests passed.
8) Rollout readiness: Canary automation configured, rollback policy proven in staged tests, and runbook accessible in Console and Confluence.
rollout_plan:
Phase 0 — Staging (internal): End-to-end smoke tests + performance profiling. Phase 1 — Canary (1%): Route 1% of traffic from non-enterprise orgs and run golden-set checks every 30 minutes, hold for 48 hours. Phase 2 — Ramp (10 → 50%): Increase traffic in steps with quality gates at each step (embedding drift, error rate, latency). Phase 3 — GA: Flip default endpoint docs, announce to customers, enable SDK examples. Rollback criteria: error rate > 0.2% sustained over 5 minutes, p95 latency > 2x target for 10 minutes, or behavioral regression detected in golden-set runner. Automation: scripted canary jobs with automatic halt and notify to on-call Slack and PagerDuty.
Cutover notes: feature flag to opt-in new behavior; migration window of 90 days for customers to adopt new flags.
monitoring_playbook: Dashboards: Per-route latency (p50/p95/p99), requests/sec, tokens/sec, cost-per-1k-tokens, error taxonomy. Quality: per-prompt-set pass rate, embedding drift histogram, rerank top-k accuracy. Alerts: SLO burn alert at 10% deviation, critical alert for error rate spikes. Playbook steps: 1) Triage in Console → link trace to PR/commit. 2) If degraded, run automated rollback. 3) If behavior-only (quality drift), open a regression ticket linking sample inputs and version. On-call rotation: runtime-eng leads first response; PM notified on high-severity incidents.
qa_and_evals:
- Regression harness: 5k prompt golden set across chat/completions; nightly runs during staging and canary.
- Stress tests: sustained QPS for bursts (2x expected peak) and load shaping to ensure autoscaling triggers correctly.
- Fuzzing: randomized prompt perturbations to detect parsing/structured-output regressions.
- Human evals: 200-sample blind eval comparing baseline vs candidate for chat quality with rubric (coherence, instruction-following, safety).
- Embedding stability bench: 10 runs across 3 instance types to validate quantization/variance.
migration_notes:
- Default behavior remains unchanged unless customers opt into new flags.
- SDK: add 'starterKit=True' shorthand and code samples; deprecation plan: log warnings for deprecated params for 60 days.
- Contract changes (if any) will use feature flags and require explicit SDK opt-in.
- Customer comms: two-phase email + dashboard banner with migration steps and sample code snippets.
open_questions:
1) Final decision on whether rerank explanations include token spans (privacy/legal review pending).
2) SLA wording for embeddings (vector stability guarantee) — legal to approve delta phrasing.
3) Whether to expose model-variant hints for autoscaler (ops requests more telemetry).
4) Confirmation of canary orgs list (security & sales to finalize).
risks_mitigations:
Risk: Behavioral regressions slip into GA causing customer churn. Mitigation: large golden-set coverage, human evals, and canary hold periods.
Risk: Cost regressions due to caching misconfiguration. Mitigation: token-level cost telemetry and preflight cost simulation.
Risk: Slow rollback in complex multi-variant flows. Mitigation: one-click rollback and pre-validated fallback variants configured in runtime.

notes: This PRD intentionally targets a minimal, opinionated surface so we can ship a coherent developer experience quickly. We will iterate after GA on additional features (composable endpoints, advanced rerank explanations). Keep this ticket focused on contract stability and launch readiness.
